incidents.name: Qixi token transfer underflow
incidents.notes: The QIXI token's unchecked fee arithmetic in transfer() underflows the liquidity pair's balance, letting the attacker inflate their own holding and swap it for the pair's WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: QIXI 0x65F11B2de17c4af7A8f70858D6CcB63AAC215697 created 2022-08-03T11:44:12Z by 0xe7ce2d402d5d6fb42471183b71d8c167bba9374b, unrelated to attack sender 0x2723e1f6a9a3cd003fd395cc46882e4573cb249f; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 6.8944 WBNB left the QIXI pair to the attack contract; 6.8944 WBNB x $294.61 at incidentTimestamp 1659539632 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $2,031.
